newsitem.title: POLAND: Goodyear to invest more in Debica.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear to invest more in Debica.

text.p: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co said it would invest a total of $93 million in Polish tyre maker T.C. Debica SA, and plans to invest $27 million this year alone, PAP news agency reported on Wednesday.
PAP said that Goodyear invested $18 million in Debica last year and that the U.S. based tyre maker planned to invest $28 million in 1998 and $20 million in 1999.
PAP also quoted Sylvain Valensi, deputy-head of Goodyear Europe, as saying that Goodyear planned to move some of its production from Germany and France to Poland.
"Some production will be eliminated in these (French and German) factories, and production will be realised in Debica," Valensi was quoted as saying.
Goodyear holds a 50.7 percent stake in Debica.
Goodyear had said it would invest $60 million to modernise Debica when it first bought a 32.7 percent stake in the Polish firm in late 1995.
